title: Metaphor: ReFantazio
provenance: Verified by the maintainer with the free Prologue Demo (Steam 3130330) on an M1 Pro, macOS 26.6.2, Highball 0.9.7, engine x64-crossover26.3-r8, 2026-09-12: title, cutscenes, dialogue and the desert run of the prologue. First reported on the full game by Napo2k (highball#80, M5 Max, macOS 26.5.2, Highball 0.8.8, engine r0). The full game, with Denuvo, has not been run here. CrossOver 24 and 26 users show it running on Apple Silicon.
notes: DirectX 11, Denuvo on the full game. Needs engine x64-crossover26.3-r8 or later: on every earlier engine the game does not reach play, and no setting changes that. Measured with the demo on r8, DXMT, 1728x1117: language and brightness prompts, the opening cutscenes, the title menu, New Game, the naming and difficulty prompts, the first dialogue and the run through the Tradia Desert prologue, 55 to 59 fps throughout by the Metal HUD, GPU 1.5 ms in cutscenes and 10 to 12 ms in the desert, no fault in 35 minutes. The first battle was not reached in that session. Why earlier engines fail, measured: on the Wine 10 engine (Sikarugir, r0 to r2) the game faults seconds after launch reading address 0x20FF in its own code, right after creating fibers and switching to one; on macOS the slot a game reads as its current fiber is the host thread's QoS class. Same crash with AVX advertised and on DXVK, so neither the CPU feature nor the graphics layer is involved. On the Wine 11 engines r5 to r7, which mirror the fiber pointer into that slot, the game opens a black window and hangs at full CPU: the mirrored pointer is what macOS's dispatch library reads as a QoS class on the main thread, and it faults on it. r8 swaps the slot between the two owners at every crossing between game code and Wine. Keyboard: Return confirms, Escape opens the pause menu with Skip for cutscenes, F fast-forwards dialogue. The Yes/No prompts default to No, so press Up before Return.

knownIssues.symptom: Engines before r8: page fault reading 0x20FF seconds after launch (Wine 10, r0 to r2), or a black window and a hang at full CPU (Wine 11, r5 to r7)
knownIssues.cause: measured: the game's fiber pointer and macOS's per-thread QoS class share one slot in the thread block; the earlier engines gave the slot to one side only
knownIssues.fix: engine x64-crossover26.3-r8 or later; no setting changes it

knownIssues.symptom: The full game with Denuvo is not verified here, only the free Prologue Demo
knownIssues.fix: one report from a full-game run fills the gap

verified.fps: 55 to 59 in the prologue desert run at 1728x1117 on DXMT (Prologue Demo), 57 to 59 in cutscenes and menus
verified.how: Steam, demo launch, language and brightness prompts, opening cutscenes (skipped one with Escape then Skip), title menu, New Game, naming and difficulty prompts, first dialogue, then the run through the Tradia Desert under keyboard control. No fault in 35 minutes. The first battle was not reached.
